subject: Clarify launch runway: timing ambiguity, enablement asks, and exception wishlist
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sandeep Rao <sandeep@NimbusAnalytics.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Dec 2029 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Clarify launch runway: timing ambiguity, enablement asks, and exception wishlist

Team —

Quick note to align before we confirm the external go/no-go with Nimbus next week. A few points I need us to lock down so procurement + their CISO can finalize the contract and the CS playbook: 

1) Launch timing: Product has suggested "late Jan" but roadmap shows Feb as the target. We need a single day-range we can commit to externally (even if soft). What is the earliest realistic date given current infra gating?

2) Enablement: Sales + CS want a 60-minute enablement walkthrough (recording + slides) + a one-page quickstart. Can we target an enablement artifact drop by Jan 12?

3) Docs: we have three remaining doc gaps called out by docs triage — KV cache behavior for long-running sessions, recommended quantization profiles for latency-sensitive routes, and a troubleshooting section for the canary fallback path. Who owns each?

4) Exceptions/wishlist: Nimbus asked for a 99.9% P99 latency SLA for read-only embedding routes on launch. That is outside our current SLA baseline. If we don't provide it, they may ask for a discount or escrow. We should list what exceptions (temporary price or capacity commitments) we're willing to offer.

Attachments: enablement-playbook-v1.pdf (draft slides), canary-capacity-estimates.xlsx (rough numbers).

Ask: please reply with: (A) earliest external-facing date range we can give, (B) doc owners for the three gaps, (C) list of acceptable exceptions and who will own negotiations with Nimbus procurement.

Thanks — Vanessa

--
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sandeep Rao <sandeep@NimbusAnalytics.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Dec 2029 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Clarify launch runway: timing ambiguity, enablement asks, and exception wishlist

Vanessa —

A quick first pass from Enablement / GTM side: 

- Timing: assuming we get the infra gating cleared (see Jonas), we can plan a public doc+webinar on Jan 18–22. That gives us two weeks to record and produce the one-pager.
- Enablement deliverables: I can take the recording and slides; my team will produce the quickstart. Target: Jan 12 artifact drop is doable if we get any outstanding technical sign-offs by Dec 20.
- Doc owners (proposal):
  * KV cache long sessions — Jonas (eng docs & runtime)
  * Quantization profiles — Karthik (applied ML / optimization)
  * Canary fallback troubleshooting — Grace (SRE / ops runbooks)

Exceptions: from GTM POV, we can accept a temporary SLA carve for embedding routes (99.9% P99) if Engineering confirms a mitigated risk plan (e.g., limited to a single region + traffic cap) and Sales gets a 6% launch credit. I can own the commercial ask with Nimbus procurement.

Attaching my annotated enablement-playbook-v1.pdf (minor edits).

—Marissa

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Dec 2029 13:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Clarify launch runway: timing ambiguity, enablement asks, and exception wishlist

Vanessa / team —

Technical constraints summary: 

- Canary capacity: the attached canary-capacity-estimates.xlsx (sheet: regional-slices) shows we can support a limited 100 qps read-only embedding slice for a single region in "soft-launch" within current reserved capacity. To guarantee 99.9% P99 we need either (a) a regional-only promise + traffic cap, or (b) an additional hot-pool reservation (approx 2x cost for the first 3 months).
- KV cache long sessions: we have observed unbounded KV growth with some multi-turn agents. We can mitigate by setting an eviction policy and recommended max prefix length; we will document this in eng docs but need product sign-off on the recommended max session length (I propose 32k tokens).
- Quantization profiles: Karthik's team already has a shortlist (int8 + Q4-aware kernels) that map well to our latency SLOs. We'll add a concise recommended table in the docs.

Earliest realistic external-facing range: Jan 18–22 is feasible if we agree on the regional SLA carve and Marissa's deadlines are met. If Nimbus insists on a global 99.9% P99 from day one, we should push to Feb 5–9 after reserving hot-pool capacity.

I will own the KV cache doc updates and the canary technical appendix.

—Jonas

Date: Wed, 4 Dec 2029 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Clarify launch runway: timing ambiguity, enablement asks, and exception wishlist

All —

Confirming I will take the quantization profiles and produce the recommended table with tradeoffs (latency vs. token quality) by Dec 18. A few notes:

- For latency-sensitive embedding routes, int8 with our Q4 kernels gives ~1.6x speedup vs fp16 in our internal perf harness; expected P99 regressions are small but we need to call out edge cases (very long contexts + high batch variance).
- I agree with Jonas on recommending a 32k token soft limit for KV sessions at launch; longer sessions should be allowed but flagged as "best-effort" with advisory text.

If we commit to Jan 18–22 externally, I will push the doc artifacts earlier (Dec 18) so Enablement has time to incorporate them.

—Karthik

Date: Wed, 4 Dec 2029 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Clarify launch runway: timing ambiguity, enablement asks, and exception wishlist

Thanks all — helpful alignment. Final notes and action owners: 

- External-facing date range: Jan 18–22 (soft) — Vanesssa to confirm with Nimbus on the "soft window" language today. If Nimbus requires a global 99.9% P99 we will escalate to finance for a hot-pool commit and push to Feb 5–9.
- Doc owners: Jonas (KV cache appendix), Karthik (quantization table), Grace (canary fallback runbook), Marissa (enablement artifacts + quickstart). Deliverables due Dec 18 (docs) / Jan 12 (enablement artifacts).
- Exceptions / commercial: Marissa will lead the commercial ask (6% launch credit + regional carve for SLA). Engineering to provide the mitigated risk plan (Jonas) and a short appendix for the SRE runbook (Grace).

I'll ping Nimbus procurement with the soft-window language and a short list of exceptions we can accept this morning. If anyone has pushback on owners or dates, flag it in the next 2 hours so I can incorporate before I send the external note.

—Vanessa
